summarize_CONFIG: summarize the Mask R-CNN ResNet-101 FPN 2x COCO configuration file
review_CONFIG: review the model backbone config that overrides ResNet-50 with ResNet-101 pretrained weights
build_CONFIG: build a detection model using the Mask R-CNN R101 FPN 2x COCO config with mmengine

refactor_CONFIG: refactor the model backbone config to use a different pretrained checkpoint
